output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The mintedAmount is not checked for overflow, allowing the totalSupply to be manipulated.
The _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The check balanceOf[_to] + _value is prone to overflow, allowing the balanceOf[_to] to be manipulated.
The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value is not checked for underflow, allowing the totalSupply to be manipulated.
The owned function has a wrong logic vulnerability. It assigns owner to msg.sender in a public function, making it susceptible to unauthorized access.
The mintToken function has a typo in its function name, causing a constructor function to be obfuscated, making it uninvokable.
